hook: A short chat about job interviews.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Have you ever had a job interview?

translation.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ đi phỏng vấn xin việc chưa?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Yes, I have. I have never worked on weekends.

translation.vi: Rồi, mình từng đi rồi. Mình chưa bao giờ làm việc vào cuối tuần.
Bạn có thích công việc của mình không?

gloss.en: a formal meeting to talk about a job
to do a job or task; effort to do something

grammar_notes: Use 'have/has + ever + past participle' to ask about life experiences. Use 'have/has + never + past participle' to say you have not done something.
interaction_prompts: Have you ever had a job interview? Tell us about it!
